posts.title: I published 10 poems this month as part of a poetry challenge
posts.description: April is Global Poetry Writing Month . Everyone participating from around the Web is encouraged to write a poem a day, optionally based on each day’s prompt . It was my first time participating in this challenge. My goal was not to pen a poem a day for the sake of it but to write verses which express what I think and feel about various things. posts.title: Realizations about actually avoiding social media
posts.description: I’ve had or re-had a few realizations lately that have helped me greatly: Crossposting to or across social media is counterproductive if doing so to avoid social media. Applies to POSSE too. Having a domain for micro thoughts, day-to-day photos, comments, and random musings is a waste of time and effort. Not all links need to be permanent.
